digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge group and subcommand routing
propositions: bridge noun with preview and sync subcommands must ship functionally without breaking existing top-level reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, or doctor commands
preview subcommand must execute read-only with no Jira or ticket-store mutations; sync subcommand must execute with full mutation capability
bridge verb dispatch must not fall through to top-level commands; group help and unknown-verb behavior must be explicit
Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode reconcile-check round-trip must survive intact through this migration boundary

documentation (user guide, CLI reference, release notes) must describe only the staged surface (preview, sync) that ships, without advertising unimplemented verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, resume)
all in-repo consumers and legacy workflows must remain functional at this story boundary
